purpose: Teach: 美奈子/貞子/アヤ/マサ/わらしべ/ガンモ/キチン/逸品

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「美奈子おばさんは絵が上手」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying that Minako-aunt is really talented at drawing.
lines.style: Gentle, conversational tone. Warm and matter-of-fact. Sharing a small family detail like it's a quiet afternoon thought. No urgency, just offering connection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「貞子は怖い」って怖がったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I got scared together watching Sadako. We were pretty spooked.
lines.style: Small, genuine laugh underneath. Self-aware about the fear — not trying to sound brave but not ashamed either. Conversational, easy. The honesty of a kid who trusts you.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「アヤちゃんはピアノが上手」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad mentioned that Aya-chan has such beautiful piano skills.
lines.style: Same warm reflective cadence as before. Slight pause before the compliment, like she's remembering exactly what he said. Admiring tone but grounded.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「マサ兄さんと一緒に泳ぐ」って約束したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad promised to take me swimming with Masa-aniki. We're going to do it together.
lines.style: Bright with anticipation. Quick, eager rhythm. The excitement of a kid with something good to look forward to. Natural, unguarded.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「わらしべ長者には知恵がある」って教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was teaching me that the Warashibe Kozo story shows the value of wisdom and kindness.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause at the start. Speaking like she's absorbing the lesson herself. Gentle, almost reverent tone — honoring what he taught her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとガンモ、つまりがんもどきを味見したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad let me taste ganmodoki with him. It was really good.
lines.style: Straightforward, pleased. Simple joy in the tasting — a shared moment. Natural kid voice, pride in the small experience.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「キチン質は環境に優しい素材」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad gave me this special sweet. It was such a thoughtful gift.
lines.style: Soft appreciation. Like he's holding something precious and wants you to know its value. Quiet wonder at being given something that mattered.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんから逸品のお菓子を頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I had such a nice time together today. Thank you for listening.
lines.style: Warm closure. Settled, content. Gratitude that's genuine and unselfconscious. The small satisfaction of having shared something good.
